trackingContract: Manual checklist steps are user-confirmed unless a step has observerSignal metadata. For stock scripts that expose only a completion counter, the observer checks the full interaction set and then emits each checklist row together; it does not claim an order or location identity. Observer signals remain source-reviewed until confirmed in a private match.
